notes.title: Get ready to open your doors for the models of "Pink Star" Fashion House!
notes.notes:
While the free demo version is still fresh and available for you to try - we suggest you check it out if you still haven’t! The full version is coming out somewhat soon though - already this June you’ll be able to dive into every little corner of Pink Star and get to know the models, their stories and unleash your own story in the walls of this mansion.We're looking closely at your feedback to fix all the little issues and to know how we could improve the full version further - so feel free to share your thoughts, it’s still a perfect opportunity to make your voice count! ✅
Thank you for your time and endeavors - it’s important and is making a difference, stick to the announcements to get to know the exact release date. 👀
Thanks for staying with us!
